message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Director | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|----------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Stanley Kubrick | A masterclass in psychological dread and iconic imagery. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Ari Aster | A chilling family saga that blends supernatural terror with raw emotion. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Jordan Peele | A smart, socially conscious horror that keeps you on edge. |
| 4 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Ari Aster | A daylight nightmare that turns a pastoral setting into a nightmare. |
| 5 | **It Follows** | 2014 | David Robert Mitchell | A fresh take on the “invisible stalker” trope with a haunting soundtrack. |
| 6 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Jennifer Kent | A psychological thriller that explores grief and motherhood. |
| 7 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | John Krasinski | Suspense built around silence—perfect for a tense movie night. |
| 8 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | James Wan | A well‑crafted paranormal investigation that balances scares and story. |
| 9 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Gore Verbinski | A modern retelling of a cursed videotape that still feels fresh. |
|10 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | Drew Goddard | A meta‑horror that subverts expectations while delivering solid scares. |

Feel free to pick based on your mood—whether you want psychological depth, supernatural chills, or a blend of both!
